preprocessing: raw scikit-learn features; feature-wise centering; no variance scaling

alpha_selection.rule: Target 75% aggregate pairwise squared L2 separation in the central half; refine the highest-alpha downward grid bracket in log(alpha)
alpha_selection.status: Floating-point convergence check, not an interval certificate

pairwise_energy_validation.mmqv_reason: Each unit trigonometric mode has one-half squared norm on an interval of length one-half; centered PCA cancels cross terms

range_protocol: Each candidate uses its own minimum/maximum curve heights, plus 5% of its span at each end

mmssqv_sign_coverage.scope: Fixed alpha, finite cutoff, and stated rendering/scoring protocol
